title: Machine-Checked Exact-Rational Variance-Hull, Two-Cap Mask, and Factor-Two Certificates for Euclidean Diameter in Dynamic Streams
abstract: Jeff Giliberti and MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi (arXiv:2611.33139, November 24, 2026) resolved the update-time bottleneck for dynamic-stream high-dimensional Euclidean diameter: for every fixed c > sqrt(3), their one-pass algorithm maintains an explicit factor-c witness pair in sublinear space O~(N^{1-eps_c} poly(d)) and worst-case update time poly(d, log N), breaking the N^{2/3} update-time barrier of direct asymmetric Gaussian embeddings at factor c=2 while matching polynomial space lower bounds. We present a machine-checked, zero-floating-point formalization and exact-Q certificate auditor for the algebraic, variance-hull, two-cap mask, and Appendix A.1 factor-two core of this construction. First, an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel (EuclideanDiameterStream.lean, Lean 4.35.0; 0 sorry, 0 warnings, 0 Classical.choice, 5 zero-axiom theorems) formalizes the cleared parallel-axis identity, Lemma 5.1's sqrt(2a^2-1) variance-hull dilation bound and two-simplex tightness, Eq. (13) bounded witness radii, Section 8.2 Algorithm 4's exact variance increment V' - V = gamma(R^2-V) - gamma^2 R^2 > (theta^2/64)V and 8V_0 cap, Lemma 8.1's candidate-score bound, the 3-4-5 spherical-cap containment t >= 3/5 => (t-3/5)^2+q <= 16/25, the SOS potential margin (lambda-t)^2 - q >= lambda^2/2 - 1, Section 8.2 geometric shrinkage |P_{i+1}| < (3/5)|P_i|, and the complete Appendix A.1 factor-two rational parameter suite (2a^2-1 = 3.999122 < 4, eps_0 > 1/6345504000 > 10^{-10}). Second, EUCLIDEAN-DIAM-CERT-1.0 audits four exact-Q modes across 16 canonical certificates (0.181-8.834 ms) and rejects 62/62 live adversarial forgeries.
